query: What are the various consumer offsets used by AdaptiveState event sourcing?

recall_results.summary: M2 alpha optimizer reads from feedback_events with its own per-consumer offset; replays past recall sessions to learn CC fusion weights.
evidence_preview: M2 alpha optimizer offset advances after replay

recall_results.summary: M3 Kaplan-Meier survival estimator tracks its own watermark over the same feedback_events log to update per-cluster decay curves.
evidence_preview: M3 survival watermark distinct from M2

recall_results.summary: M5 tiering recompute uses its own watermark over feedback_events to track which events have already informed the t-digest streaming quantile estimator.
ARS Capability A concept summary refresh holds its own watermark; v0.24 cross-cutting refactor unified the peek+commit pattern across every reader.
Resummerize audit recheck advances its own watermark to drive the 3-strike exhaustion fuse off the resummarize_runs status stream.
evidence_preview: audit table is the source of truth

query: How do the lossless compression contract invariants gate canonical rewrites?

recall_results.summary: Invariant 1 of the contract checks no_new_facts: the rewritten canonical may not introduce trigrams absent from the source evidence corpus.
evidence_preview: trigrams from evidence rows form the allowlist
rewrite rejected if novel trigrams appear

recall_results.summary: Invariant 2 enforces length_bounded: rewritten output must be at least 30 percent shorter than the keep-tail input but not below a minimum canonical floor.
Invariants 3 and 4 enforce keyword_preservation and entity_preservation: high-frequency keywords and named entities from evidence must survive the rewrite.
Invariant 5 (numeric_preservation) guards numbers; invariant 6 (date_preservation) guards ISO dates and relative time markers.
Invariant 7 is shape_consistency: the rewrite must keep the structural shape of the canonical (bullet lists stay bullet lists, prose stays prose).

query: What MCP tools were added in v0.23 / v0.24 / v0.25 and how do they fit together?

recall_results.summary: v0.23.0 shipped rein_resummerize as a new MCP tool — operator-driven LLM canonical rewrite gated by the lossless contract; opt-in via [resummerize].enabled.
evidence_preview: rein_resummerize is the new MCP tool

recall_results.summary: v0.24.0 introduced rein_concept_summary_refresh and rein_concept_state to expose the ARS Capability A living-summary refresh path; both opt-in via [ars].concept_summary_enabled.
rein_dedup_concepts arrived in v0.24 to drive the SemDeDup P90 per-cluster threshold loop on the concepts side.
v0.25.0 extended rein_recall with synthesize=true rather than introducing a new tool, keeping the surface stable.
evidence_preview: no new tool added in v0.25.0

query: Where do the test-support mock implementations live and what do they cover?

recall_results.summary: embed/mock.rs defines MockEmbedder behind the test-support feature; integration tests use it to script vector responses for run_vec_dedup_with_embedder.
extract/llm.rs::MockExtractor sits behind the same test-support feature; uses a FIFO response queue with explicit exhausted error so under-provisioned tests fail loudly.
MockExtractorProbe complements MockExtractor with a call-count probe so tests can assert how many LLM calls a code path issued.
test-support mocks are absent from the release binary: they are gated by a Cargo feature so production builds never link them in.

query: What does evidence-aware recall mean and which channels feed it?

recall_results.summary: Evidence-aware recall means each candidate carries both its canonical summary and a preview of the evidence rows that support it; the rerank uses both signals.
evidence_preview: candidate carries canonical plus evidence preview

recall_results.summary: Tantivy BM25 returns canonicals; the recall layer fans out to fetch a small evidence preview per canonical so the operator sees sources without N+1 round-trips.
usearch HNSW vector channel returns canonical IDs; the same evidence-preview batch fetch path applies, keyed by canonical.
evidence_preview: shared batch fetch path for evidence preview

recall_results.summary: Knowledge-graph BFS surfaces concept-linked memories; canonical-first collapse merges duplicates before evidence preview is computed.

query: How does the v0.23 resummerize side-index discipline work?

recall_results.summary: After a successful apply_resummerize, refresh_indexes_after_canonical_rewrite triggers Tantivy refresh inside the same write transaction.
The same path issues a sqlite-vec delete for the old vector row in-transaction so the vector table never carries stale embeddings tied to the rewritten canonical.
needs_vec_dedup is set to 1 after rewrite to enqueue an adaptive-pipeline re-embed pass that re-inserts the new canonical into HNSW.
Audit row in resummarize_runs records the side-index outcome so a doctor pass can detect drift between Tantivy / sqlite-vec / HNSW for any rewritten canonical.
